name: wx-vsce-markdown-live-preview
description: Live Markdown preview on a Rust/WASM engine — incremental block patching, math (KaTeX), mermaid, GitHub alerts, TOC, two-way scroll sync, and Edit/Split/Preview modes

commands.title: Toggle Focus Between Editor and Preview

commandPalette.when: editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || resourceExtname == .md || resourceExtname == .markdown || resourceExtname == .mdx
editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || resourceExtname == .md || resourceExtname == .markdown || resourceExtname == .mdx
editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || resourceExtname == .md || resourceExtname == .markdown || resourceExtname == .mdx || markdownLivePreview.previewVisible
editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || resourceExtname == .md || resourceExtname == .markdown || resourceExtname == .mdx || markdownLivePreview.previewVisible
editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || resourceExtname == .md || resourceExtname == .markdown || resourceExtname == .mdx || markdownLivePreview.previewVisible

editor/title.when: (editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || resourceExtname == .md || resourceExtname == .markdown || resourceExtname == .mdx) && !markdownLivePreview.previewVisible
(editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || resourceExtname == .md || resourceExtname == .markdown || resourceExtname == .mdx) && markdownLivePreview.previewVisible

keybindings.when: editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || activeWebviewPanelId == markdownLivePreview.preview
editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || activeWebviewPanelId == markdownLivePreview.preview
editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == mdx || activeWebviewPanelId == markdownLivePreview.preview

markdownLivePreview.scrollSync.description: Two-way scroll sync between the editor and the preview.

markdownLivePreview.lockPreviewGroup.description: Lock the editor group the side preview opens in, so newly-opened files land in the main group instead of replacing the preview.

markdownLivePreview.defaultMode.description: View mode used when opening a preview without an explicit placement.

markdownLivePreview.breaks.description: Render a single newline inside a paragraph as a line break.

markdownLivePreview.linkify.description: Automatically turn bare URLs into clickable links.

markdownLivePreview.typographer.description: Smart punctuation: curly quotes, dashes, and ellipses.

markdownLivePreview.html.enabled.description: Render raw HTML in the document (always sanitized). When disabled, raw HTML is shown escaped.

markdownLivePreview.math.enabled.description: Render LaTeX math expressions ($inline$ and $$display$$) via KaTeX.

markdownLivePreview.mermaid.enabled.description: Render ```mermaid fenced code blocks as diagrams.

markdownLivePreview.mermaid.theme.description: Mermaid diagram theme. `auto` follows the preview theme.

markdownLivePreview.frontmatter.display.description: How to show leading YAML frontmatter.

markdownLivePreview.theme.description: Preview theme. `auto` follows the VSCode color theme.

markdownLivePreview.customCss.description: Workspace-relative CSS files appended to the preview, in order.

markdownLivePreview.toc.visible.description: Show the table-of-contents sidebar by default.

markdownLivePreview.taskLists.toggleFrom.description: Allow clicking task-list checkboxes in the preview to toggle `[ ]`/`[x]` in the source file. This is the extension's only write path; off by default.

markdownLivePreview.wikiLinks.enabled.description: Render `[[wiki links]]` as relative links (rendering only, no resolution).

scripts.package: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
